serverCompatibility.notes: Production Stable channel paired with live SoulspireXI main server.

tagline: Faerie Companions (Eos & Titania) • Job Specs • 4-Tier Weaponskill Talent Trees

news.title: Custom OverlordsXI Launcher Icon & Branding (v1.0.9)
news.body: Added a custom high-contrast OverlordsXI gold & cyan crystal emblem for OverlordsLauncher.exe, the taskbar, title bar, and hero banner.

news.title: Kazenoeye Server-Synced Debuff Timers (v1.0.8)
news.body: kazenoeye now pulls active mob status effects and exact remaining durations directly from the OverlordsXI server (0x1FE OXKE sync) so timers are always real and never guessed.

news.title: QOL Addons Included: Mob Levels & Mob Debuff HUD
news.body: The launcher now includes checker (exact monster level on /check), mobdb (target mob level range, aggro & weaknesses), and kazenoeye (floating HP bar and debuff icons/timers above mob models) by default.

news.title: Scholar Call Eos & Call Titania Companions
news.body: Summon Eos (Medic Light Arts) or Titania (Sage Dark Arts enfeebling & nuking dark fairy) via crystal unlocks, and switch crystals with !spec.

news.title: OverlordsXI Launcher & Auto-Updater
news.body: Distributable Ashita v4 launcher with automatic DAT overlay (Pivot) and overlords_talents addon syncing, FFXI install detection, and graphics configuration.

news.title: 192 Bespoke 4-Tier Weaponskill Talent Trees
news.body: Use /talents (or /tal) in-game with the Ashita addon loaded, or !talent without the addon, to customize all 207 player weaponskills.

optionalOverlays.name: COR Flintlock Dual Pistols (AkimboRA v3.7 Compact 75%)
optionalOverlays.description: Optional visual-only dual-pistol ranged attack and Mariner hip-holster overlay for COR Flintlock (75% compact scale, 7 player skeletons, 26 firearm models). Disabled by default to avoid affecting other Souls.
